title: Up on an empty prompt opens the prompt history
body:
`/history` opens a box of the prompts sent in this run, but no key opened it, and Up on a one-row prompt did nothing. Jack asked for Up to recall earlier prompts without the behaviour where Up past the top row of a draft replaces the draft with history.

## Proposal

- Up on an empty prompt opens the `/history` box. With any text in the prompt, Up only moves the cursor.
- The history box is at most 60 columns wide and 10 rows tall, and a prompt of several lines shows its line count.
- A resumed session's prompts join the history.

## Rejected

- Stepping through history in the prompt box itself, as Claude Code does. Once a recalled prompt fills the box, Up has to keep stepping history, which needs a browsing state that edits end. A list box avoids that state.
